photos.desc: We spotted several common loons on the open water of this partially frozen lake in Minnesota. Some were resting and preening while others were fishing for crayfish! Photo by Courtney Celley/USFWS.
We spotted this common loon on a wetland in a Waterfowl Production Area along Swift and Kandiyohi Counties in Minnesota. Photo by Mike Budd/USFWS.
We spotted this common loon on Bird Lake in the Superior National Forest in St. Louis County, Minnesota. Photo by Courtney Celley/USFWS.
We spotted this common loon relaxing and preening on calm, quiet waters in northern Minnesota. Photo by Courtney Celley/USFWS.
